affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 992 was recorded at Army entry on 21 February 1944. The code names no school, course, employer, start date or Army-to-OSS transfer date.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier selects one of two same-name Army rows and excludes the older Detroit Urban League namesake. Student status is not converted into an institutional affiliation or employer.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 721 was recorded at Army entry on 25 April 1942. The grouped code names no employer, mine, machine, workplace, start date or Army-to-OSS transfer date.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and exact full name confirm the row. No employer, mine, machine, location, exact duties, or Army-to-OSS sequence is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed John Dancy is confirmed as the person recorded entering the United States Army on February 21, 1944.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact indexed private identifier selects one of two same-name Army merged-file rows.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized name; the selected row records birth year 1926.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated 21 February 1944; the OSS transfer date is unknown.
claims.match_notes: Two newspaper references to adult Detroit Urban League director John C. Dancy were rejected as an older namesake. The full private identifier remains private.
